extracted.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
extracted.description: This recipe combines butter, garlic powder, and frozen shrimp for a quick and easy main dish ready in 15 minutes or less.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons garlic powder, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large skillet or wok over medium-low heat. Add shrimp; cook and stir until shrimp turn pink, about 5 minutes. Mix in garlic powder.
Whisk water and cornstarch together in a bowl to make a slurry. Pour into the skillet and stir until butter sauce thickens, 3 to 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
